images.title: What are embeddings in AI?
images.subtitle: Lists of numbers that let a computer tell which pieces of text mean something similar.

images.title: An embedding is a shelf position on a map of meaning

pairs.left: Pasta is far from cat food

pairs.right: Hundreds or thousands place a text

images.note: Where it stops: a shop has two or three dimensions. Real embeddings have hundreds or thousands.

images.title: Meaning-based search finds what keywords miss

columns.heading: Keyword search
items: Looks for the exact word you typed
Misses a page titled 'Get your money back'
Finds pages that repeat the word

columns.heading: Semantic search
items: Compares the meaning of query and pages
Finds 'Get your money back' as a close match
Can also return loosely related pages

images.verdict: Some search tools use both, since exact words help with names and codes.

images.title: Text goes in, a dot on the map comes out

items.label: Your text
items.text: A phrase, a paragraph or a product description.

items.label: Embedding model
items.text: A model trained to place text on the map.

items.label: List of numbers
items.text: For example 1,536 numbers, such as 0.02, -0.13, 0.07 and so on.

images.note: The numbers shown are made up. Real values come from the model.
